body_markdown:
**Environment:**


- NewsBlur Android App
- Setting: “Mark as read on scroll” is disabled


**Description:**


Roughly 10%–20% of the time when tapping to open a folder view, the top ~6 stories in the feed load already marked as read, while the rest remain unread. No scrolling or manual interaction takes place before this occurs.


**Behavior:**


- **Expected:** All unread stories in the folder remain unread when folder is opened.
- **Actual:** Top ~6 stories load in a read state.
- **Workaround attempt:** Backing out of the folder and re-entering sometimes restores them to unread, but not consistently.


I’ve noticed this issue for a very long time, but I just manually mark each as unread and go about my day. It just happened again so I thought I should report it. Thanks as always!
